title: Investigate ordinary item-parameter byte00 reachability
changes: Record the original byte00 formatter dispatch and distinguish it from the byte01 reader, retaining dynamic producers as open.
validation: A protected Wine static screen of 58045 E132 decoded programs and 16635 expanded strings finds no extended 67 [1], compact 81 [1] or expanded 40 67 01; compact 81 [0] occurs 15 times (e132-byte00-textscan-78suaoix).

Original EUR disassembly identifies formatter selector 1, compact opcode mapping and two scoped direct callers; no game replay or performance measurement (e132-byte00-dispatch-x_kvdhlr, e132-byte00-callers-46bhd9gj, e132-byte00-compact-81n7kxzq, e132-byte00-direct-refs-i3y2fh32, e132-byte00-producers-uvjzdkyv).
limitations: Generated RAM text, unscanned sources, indirect calls and ordinary byte00 use remain unproved; Linux, USA and native Windows remain pending.
